Usage: adaptive-agent-harness <COMMAND>

Commands:
  run                          Run the Mojentic-backed agent selected by the resolved contract profile
  run-sequential               Run bounded natural attempts on one retained worker artifact
  analyze-trace                Summarize context assembly and tool payload pressure from trace JSONL files
  render-transcript            Render one or more harness traces as a self-contained HTML transcript
  summarize-matrix             Summarize the preserved 30-cell demo matrix baseline into canonical counts (harness completion, independent validation, hard-stops, environment corrections), replacing matrix-specific classification
  resolve-contract             Resolve a run contract without starting a provider or gateway: either a legacy Markdown `task.md` (via shell-fence scraping) or an explicit contract JSON file. Prints the resolved contract. This is both the no-provider resolution command and the snapshot generator/checker for `fixtures/contracts/snapshots/`
  plan-task                    Propose and validate a measurement-only acceptance checklist without starting the worker loop or exposing tools
  plan-interactions            Propose and validate measurement-only combined scenarios over a fixed acceptance plan without starting the worker loop or exposing tools
  author-interaction-evidence  Author and validate measurement-only evidence for one deterministic interaction candidate without starting the worker loop or exposing tools
  help                         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Run the Mojentic-backed agent selected by the resolved contract profile

Usage: adaptive-agent-harness run [OPTIONS] --experiment <EXPERIMENT>

Options:
      --recover-requests
          Recover eligible wire requests. Never replays model interactions or tools
      --recovery-max-attempts <RECOVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS>
          Wire attempts per completion, including the first; separate from interaction/depth budgets [default: 1]
      --recovery-retryable-status <RECOVERY_RETRYABLE_STATUS>
          Explicit HTTP retry status selection (repeatable); permanent 400/401/403 remain ineligible
      --recovery-base-delay-ms <RECOVERY_BASE_DELAY_MS>
          Initial jitter ceiling in milliseconds [default: 100]
      --recovery-delay-ceiling-ms <RECOVERY_DELAY_CEILING_MS>
          Maximum permissible delay, including Retry-After [default: 30000]
      --recovery-budget-ms <RECOVERY_BUDGET_MS>
          Recovery budget after failure, in milliseconds; never a generation timeout
      --recovery-admission-command <RECOVERY_ADMISSION_COMMAND>
          Trusted executable outside the tool root; JSON proof on stdout, metadata on stdin
      --recovery-capture-dir <RECOVERY_CAPTURE_DIR>
          Opt-in credential-filtered HTTP bodies outside the tool root; allowed with one attempt and recovery disabled
      --experiment <EXPERIMENT>
          Experiment root. Tool access is scoped to this directory
      --trace-dir <TRACE_DIR>
          Trace destination. Defaults to `<experiment>/traces`; may be placed outside the tool-visible experiment root by an external evaluator
      --goal <GOAL>
          Goal file, relative to the experiment root unless absolute [default: task.md]
      --contract <CONTRACT>
          Explicit run-contract JSON file, relative to the experiment root unless absolute
      --provider <PROVIDER>
          Local inference provider. Uses OMLX_HOST or OLLAMA_HOST [default: omlx] [possible values: omlx, ollama]
      --model <MODEL>
          Provider model ID. Defaults to Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-8bit (oMLX) or qwen3.8:27b-mxfp8 (Ollama)
      --max-iterations <MAX_ITERATIONS>
          Maximum Mojentic iterative-solver turns [default: 10]
      --max-model-interactions <MAX_MODEL_INTERACTIONS>
          Maximum model interaction cycles per agent turn [default: 75]
      --context-window-tokens <CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS>
          Context window for harness accounting and Ollama num_ctx; configure the actual oMLX limit on the server. Defaults to 262144 for Qwen3.8-27B-MLX-8bit and Mojentic accounting otherwise
      --packet-type <PACKET_TYPE>
          Packet type used for default output-token budgeting [default: multi-file-edit]
      --expected-output-tokens <EXPECTED_OUTPUT_TOKENS>
          Override the packet output-token budget
      --max-tokens <MAX_TOKENS>
          Maximum generated tokens per request, including reasoning (default: 16384) [alias: --num-predict]
      --reasoning-effort <REASONING_EFFORT>
          Worker reasoning effort: disabled, enabled, low, medium, high, xhigh. Omit for the model default. Named levels depend on the model's chat template; advisory calls keep their defaults
      --reasoning-profile <REASONING_PROFILE>
          Explicit model capability profile; omit to leave validation to the provider [possible values: qwen3.8]
      --preserve-reasoning
          Preserve completed native assistant reasoning in history (separate from capped checkpoints)
      --max-thinking-only-tokens <MAX_THINKING_ONLY_TOKENS>
          Max reasoning-only tokens in one LLM call before an action-only handoff. Disabled by default; positive values explicitly opt into interruption
      --repair-exit-thinking-tokens <REPAIR_EXIT_THINKING_TOKENS>
          Post-validation hidden-only reasoning interruption. Disabled by default; positive values opt in
      --repair-handoff-policy <REPAIR_HANDOFF_POLICY>
          Action handoff policy: text-only preserves the legacy continuation; constrained ends the failed-probe turn and exposes only repair-action tools; constrained-action-only disables model reasoning after a capped repair attempt, withholding arbitrary shell during the native action-only request [default: text-only]
      --action-boundary-interrupt-tokens <ACTION_BOUNDARY_INTERRUPT_TOKENS>
          Pre-validation hidden action-intent reasoning tokens before interrupting and forcing an action. 0 disables [default: 0]
      --reasoning-checkpoint-tokens <REASONING_CHECKPOINT_TOKENS>
          Retain this many tokens (approximately) from the tail of a hidden-only no-action turn as a continuity checkpoint for the next ordinary turn. This does not disable reasoning or narrow the tool surface. 0 disables [default: 0]
      --transcript-policy <TRANSCRIPT_POLICY>
          Transcript retention policy for model/tool context [default: summarized-transcript]
      --initial-context-catalog <INITIAL_CONTEXT_CATALOG>
          Adapter-owned initial-context catalog JSON. Task-only assembly when omitted
      --semantic-advisor-model <SEMANTIC_ADVISOR_MODEL>
          Model used for isolated semantic advisory calls. Defaults to the worker model
      --acceptance-ledger
          Generate a proposal-derived acceptance checklist and interaction ledger, retain it in worker context, and require current coverage before DONE. Ledger coverage is advisory and does not replace declared probes
  -h, --help
          Print help

Examples:
  adaptive-agent-harness run --experiment /work/new-cell --provider ollama
  adaptive-agent-harness run --experiment /work/new-cell --recover-requests --recovery-max-attempts 2 --recovery-admission-command /opt/operator/owned-receipt

Wire attempts resend one immutable completion; they do not consume model interactions or replay tools. Recovery is disabled by default. SIGINT/SIGTERM persist terminal request evidence before exit.

Options:
      --output <OUTPUT>      Destination HTML file
      --title <TITLE>        Report title embedded in the single-file transcript [default: "Agent Transcript"]
      --evidence <EVIDENCE>  Optional generic transcript_evidence.v1 JSON file
